description: Modify an open cart before checkout. op: 'add' appends items, 'remove' drops items by 0-based index, 'set' replaces the full item list, 'clear' empties the cart. Merges customer details (name, email, phone) via the customer field. Call get_cart afterwards to confirm. Cannot modify a cart that already has a checkout in progress.

cart_id.description: Id of the cart, as returned when the cart was created. Carts expire after 24 hours without changes

customer.description: Customer details: real name, email and South African mobile number, plus delivery address and city. Placeholder details are refused at checkout

address.description: Street delivery address. A real address is required before payment

city.description: Delivery town or city, for example Knysna or Johannesburg

email.description: Real customer email, checked before checkout creation

name.description: Real customer name, checked before checkout creation

phone.description: South African phone number, checked before checkout creation

indices.description: Item indices to remove (0-based) when op='remove'

items.description: Blinds for op add or set, each with product_id, width_mm, height_mm, colour and mount_type. The server recalculates all prices

colour.description: Exact available colour; validate with configure_product before adding

finish.description: Optional pricing finish for aluminium Venetians

mount_type.description: Use inside for inside mount or outside for outside mount

no_drill.description: Optional. true for the no-drill option (tension brackets, inside the frame, max 2000mm wide; 1500mm on 25mm venetians). Adds the R65 no-drill kit per blind. Offered on indoor roller blinds, including value rollers, and 25mm aluminium or aluwood venetians. Dedicated no-drill products already include the kit.

product_id.description: product_id returned by search_catalog or lookup_catalog

product_name.description: Optional; server resolves the catalogue name

total_price_zar.description: Optional, ignored: server recalculates all totals

unit_price_zar.description: Optional, ignored: server recalculates all prices

op.description: add appends items; remove drops the items at the 0-based positions given in indices; set (the default) replaces the whole list with items; clear empties the cart

name: update_cart
title: Update a cart
